ios.desc:
Turn any long video into a clear summary in seconds.

Paste a YouTube link and get the key points, chapter-by-chapter notes and a full transcript before the intro is even over. No more scrubbing through a 40-minute video for the one thing you actually needed.

WHAT YOU GET
- AI summaries in seconds: paste a link, get the essentials
- Tap-to-jump timestamps: every key moment links back to the exact second in the video
- Key moments and chapters: see the structure of a video at a glance
- Full transcript: read the video as text
- Listen instead of reading: natural text-to-speech reads your summary aloud
- Summaries in your language: watch in English, read the summary in your own language
- History and time saved: every summary is stored, with the minutes you saved
- Share and copy: send a summary to a friend, a notes app or your study group

9 SUMMARY STYLES
Short Summary - Detailed Summary - Q&A - Technical Analysis - Key Moments - General Flow - Storytelling - Step by Step - Tips and Tricks

Pick the format that fits the moment: quick bullets before a meeting, step-by-step notes for a tutorial, Q&A for exam revision.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Copy the link from the YouTube app (Share, then Copy link)
2. Paste it in, choose your summary style and language
3. Read, listen, save or share

PERFECT FOR
- Students: lecture videos and tutorials turned into study notes
- Researchers: conference talks and interviews reduced to the findings
- Professionals: training videos, webinars and market updates in minutes
- Curious people: watch less, learn more

READING MODE
Adjust font size and text colour so long summaries stay comfortable to read.

PREMIUM
Free summaries to start. Premium unlocks unlimited summaries, every summary style, read-aloud in all supported languages, and no waiting.

Weekly, yearly and one-time lifetime plans are available. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://videosummary.vistamobile.co/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://videosummary.vistamobile.co/terms-of-use
Support: https://videosummary.vistamobile.co/support

Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by YouTube or Google. This is an independent third-party tool that summarizes publicly available videos you choose.
